A [[Color/Legends|blonde]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]], blue-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] '''Human''' was an [[Imperial Knight]] who served [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], she [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|sparred]] with Fel on the Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]&mdash;the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Empire-in-exile. Early in [[138 ABY|the following year]], she was present at a [[Imperial Knight remembrance ceremony|ceremony]] honoring Imperial Knights who had [[Death/Legends|fallen]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] with the [[One Sith|Sith]] during a recent [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].

==Biography==
[[File:IKceremony.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The blue-eyed Human (far left) attends a remembrance ceremony for her fallen brethren.]]
During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|blonde]] hair and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="Legacy 29" /> was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy War 1" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] who served [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> In [[137 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 29" /> she<ref name="JC2" /> [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] the Emperor in a sparring session on the Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. The session was interrupted by a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] call from [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy 29" /> the leader of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="LECG" /> whose [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] informed Fel of recent developments during a [[Mission to Had Abbadon|mission]] to the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Had Abbadon]]. Fel gave Draco new orders before bidding him farewell and continuing his sparring session with the blue-eyed Human.<ref name="Legacy 29" />

Later in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Fel and a large group of Imperial Knights were [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]] by a [[One Sith|Sith]] strike force while on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]<ref name="Legacy 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref> [[Mission to Agamar|negotiating]] an alliance with representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref> Although most of the Imperial Knights and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escaped the planet,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> several were [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> Early in [[138 ABY]], the Emperor hosted a [[Imperial Knight remembrance ceremony|remembrance ceremony]] on Bastion to pay tribute to the fallen Imperial Knights, as well as to Antares Draco, who had been captured by the Sith during a recent [[Mission to Korriban (Second Imperial Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Korriban/Legends|homeworld of the One Sith]]. The blue-eyed Human attended the ceremony.<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

==Personality and traits==
The Imperial Knight had bright blonde hair that fell just above her shoulders, bright azure eyes, and fair skin. Her body was of an athletic build.<ref name="Legacy 29" />

==Powers and abilities==
As an Imperial Knight, the blue-eyed Human was Force-sensitive, as she was part of an organization whose membership was exclusive to those who were able to manipulate [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

==Equipment==
The blue-eyed Imperial Knight used an [[Imperial Knight lightsaber]] while she sparred with Roan Fel, and although she wore casual [[Clothing/Legends|attire]] while training with the Emperor,<ref name="Legacy 29" /> she dressed in standard [[Imperial Knight armor]] at the remembrance ceremony for the Imperial Knights who have died in a Sith attack on Bastion.<ref name="Legacy War 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|She was meant to be the same Knight in the sparring scene. Hair is a different color, I know. Maybe chalk that up to lighting, I guess&hellip;|Jan Duursema|<ref name="Duursema">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31459953|board=Literature|thread=Legacy: War #2|user=[[Jan Duursema|Jan_Duursema]]|date=2011-01-03|time=9:55 AM}}</ref>}}
The Human Imperial Knight first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 29|twenty-ninth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', which was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 29" /> on [[October 29]], [[2008]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54401/star_wars_legacy_2006_29|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #29}}</ref> The Knight's hair was colored brown in that issue, but Duursema confirmed on [[TheForce.net]]'s [[Jedi Council Forums]] that the two characters were one and the same, and attributed the color difference to lighting.<ref name="Duursema" /> Ostrander later stated that he and Duursema had intended to develop the character further but were unable to do so before ''Legacy'' was canceled.<ref name="JC2" />
